description: This file defines the Lexer class within the JmesPath namespace, responsible for tokenizing JMESPath expressions into identifiable tokens for parsing. It includes token definitions, transition tables for character analysis, and methods for tokenizing input strings.

classes.name: Lexer
classes.description: A class that tokenizes JMESPath expressions into a sequence of tokens for parsing purposes.

methods.name: tokenize
methods.description: Converts a JMESPath expression string into an array of tokens, each representing syntactic components of the expression.
